europe_now.title: Severe Civil Unrest Across France
europe_now.summary: Nationwide demonstrations in France have degenerated into severe rioting and extensive property destruction. Security forces have carried out mass arrests following violent clashes in multiple cities.

sources.headline: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests
'Like we had a war': France left reeling after nationwide violent protests

europe_now.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike in Saint Petersburg
europe_now.summary: A large-scale drone attack conducted by Ukraine struck an oil facility in Saint Petersburg. The impact resulted in a major fire and reported casualties at the targeted location.

sources.headline: Ukrainian drone attack on Saint Petersburg kills one, sets refinery ablaze
Ukraine strikes oil facility in St. Petersburg as part of ‘massive’ drone attack

top_stories.title: French Protests and Security Response
top_stories.summary: Massive protests across France have resulted in widespread property destruction and over a thousand arrests. Security forces deployed riot police to contain ongoing clashes and looting in urban areas.

top_stories.title: Cross-Border Infrastructure Attacks
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes targeted energy infrastructure inside Russia, hitting an oil facility in Saint Petersburg. The attack caused significant fires and added to escalating regional security tensions.
